result.document_summary: A middle portion of the San Diego Municipal Code as published on a code-publisher site, covering the end of Ch. 3 Art. 8 (transient tax enforcement provisions) and the start of Art. 9 (Earned Sick Leave and Minimum Wage Ordinance).
result.notes: This part contains only transient occupancy/transportation tax administration provisions and employee earned sick leave and minimum wage provisions, none of which fall within the six rental housing categories. The URL slug refers to San Diego's algorithmic rent-price-fixing prohibition (Division 11, SDMC 98.1103), but that section's text does not appear in this part of the document, so no algorithmic_rent_setting rule can be extracted from it.
